text: Indeed, none of those who [expectantly] wait for You will be ashamed; Those who turn away from what is right and deal treacherously without cause will be ashamed (humiliated, embarrassed).
Do not remember the sins of my youth or my transgressions; According to Your lovingkindness remember me, For Your goodness' sake, O LORD.
For Your name's sake, O LORD, Pardon my wickedness and my guilt, for they are great.
My eyes are continually toward the LORD, For He will bring my feet out of the net.
O God, redeem Israel, Out of all his troubles.
